svg.title: The Four Waves of Enterprise Technology - Historical Inflection Analysis
svg.desc: Comparative architectural diagram illustrating the four platform cycles: Mainframe (1960s-70s), Client-Server & ERP (1980s-90s), Cloud & SaaS (2000s-10s), and the architectural break of Applied Agentics (2020s+) which lands directly on existing enterprise systems with zero-year wait.

g.text: THE FOUR WAVES OF ENTERPRISE PLATFORMS
Three decade-long platform replacements. One immediate architectural break.
“The first three waves replaced the foundation. The fourth wave activates what you already built.”
